QuestInfo.name: Taking Out the Alligators 2
QuestInfo.0: #p506# of #m10004000# is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong?
QuestInfo.1: I went to see #p506#, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to #m10004000#. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill #r120 #o46#s#k and bring back #b50 #t4000041#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: At #p506#'s request, I took out 120 #o46#s in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators so they don't spawn out of control.

0.0: Good to see you again. Actually, I've been waiting for you. I never had a chance to formally thank you for taking out the Ligators at the swamp before. Thanks to your heroics, the people at the tribe had been feeling safe passing by the area.
0.1: Lately, however, we found out that a bunch of #r#o46#s#k have been residing in the deeper parts of the swamp. #r#o46#s#k are much more powerful and intimidating than #o29#s, and they can cause havoc unlike any of the alligators in this world. So here I am, asking you for help one more time. Please help us take out the alligators. Can you do that for us?

yes.0: Thank you so much. I honestly couldn't think of anyone else to ask for a task like this. Please head to the swamp, take out #r120 #o46#s#k, and bring #b50 #t4000041#s#k back with you. Don't worry, you'll be rewarded well for this.

no.0: Ah... Please reconsider. We need your help, but--oh, I'm sorry... You must be busy with something else. But please think about it, and if you have a change of heart, return to me.

1.0: You are truly amazing. You singlehandedly took out all those #r#o46#s#k! Thanks to your incredible effort, we can all feel safe now walking across the swamp.
1.1: Here's your reward. Please choose one to your liking.

yes.0: Thank you so much. Your heroics will be recorded and passed down from generation to generation amongst our tribe, and we'll make good use of these #b#t4000041#s#k. They are a high quality leather that can be used for multiple purposes. I hope you have a safe journey. Best of luck to you.
